name: @zhushanwen/pi-file-lock
description: Shared sync cross-process file lock for Pi extensions — zero-dependency self-implemented mkdir lock (mutex-compatible with proper-lockfile 4.1.2), aligned with the runtime-side lock protocol (shared library, not a Pi extension).
